name: Chiemgau Camping Lambach
beschreibung: The campsite Chiemgau Camping Lambach is located in Seebruck in the Tiroler Unterland. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and forests. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature. There are hiking trails and ski areas nearby. The amenities include pitches with electricity hookup and sanitary building. Guests can expect a simple and functional environment. The site serves as a starting point for activities in nature.
